balls.text: Full and going down leg, Ramandeep shuffles across to sweep and misses. Umpire thinks that's fine but KKR review that for wide. Third umpire reckons that's just fine and KKR finish on 220
Yorker on off, Rinku's bottom hand comes off as he chips it down to long-on
Rinku takes on another full toss, but can't get that clean connection. Came off high on the bat. But it doesn't carry to deep midwicket. They do well to get two
There's the boundary! Sliced over point and KKR get close to 220. Full toss outside off and Rinku punishes it
137kph yorker on off, Ramandeep does well to keep this out! After his first over, Bumrah has been so so good!
Full toss on his body, Rinku, backing away, flicks it towards deep square leg, where the catch is taken. No six, but more importantly for KKR, Rinku is not on strike as they took the single
Bumrah tries to follow Rinku down leg, but it goes down leg. Another free hit coming up
Rinku backs away and Bumrah goes wide and across. No wide given. But Bumrah's overstepped! Bumrah's foot just on the line. Was such a good delivery
Low full toss on off, he swings it away towards deep midwicket. They come back for a second, and the throw at the non-striker's end is a poor one, otherwise the batter was in trouble
Full around middle, Rinku again can't connect cleanly as he swings it out to deep square leg
Length ball outside off, Ramandeep swings it down to long-on

Sliced in the air, and taken! Hardik bowls it away from Raghuvanshi, making him reach out and he skies it off the toe end towards deep cover. Tilak settles under it and this time, Raghuvanshi's catch is taken.

Sliced away over backward point! A third IPL fifty for Angkrish Raghuvanshi. At the Wankhede for the Mumbai boy. That wasn't a bad ball, yorker length outside off. Raghuvanshi hammers it away with an open face to get that placement

Hardik sees Raghuvanshi shuffle across and tries to go wide of his arc. Raghuvanshi still can't reach it as the ball veers away from him. Umpire reckons that's wide even with Raghuvanshi's movement before the delivery
In the blockhole on leg, swung away on the bounce to deep midwicket. Couldn't quite get under that. 200 up for KKR
Rinku moves leg side, Bumrah follows him and Rinku is able to squeeze it out through point
Now Bumrah goes for the pace-on yorker. Raghuvanshi jams his bat down and gets it through midwicket
Low full toss around leg, Rinku backs away and squeezes it out to long-off
Low full toss, eased to long-on
Raghuvanshi looks to back away but Bumrah follows him with a pin-point toe crusher. Angkrish can only block it back to the bowler
Raghuvanshi sweeps Bumrah behind square leg for four! 23 balls for the fifty partnership. Raghuvanshi walks across as Bumrah goes for the slower yorker-turned-full toss. Swats it away in the gap

Rinku Singh is resourceful as ever! This is a back of length delivery meant to cramp Rinku for room. But he stands tall and waits on this slower ball before swatting it away between backward point and short third
Shardul beats the swing! On a length around off and angled across at 116kph, the ball stays low as well as Rinku misses his drive on the off side
Short outside off, he swats it down into the midwicket region, bringing the bat down and across
Classy stuff from Raghuvanshi! Attempted yorker becomes a slot ball outside off and he launches it over long-off

Raghuvanshi misses out! And almost gets run out! Slot ball around off, he nails a cover drive but picks out the fielder. They'd taken off for the single, and the throw at the non-striker's end goes just wide, with Raghuvanshi short of the crease. They get a second as well thanks to the overthrow
Very full on leg, swung away along the carpet to deep square leg
Full outside off, Rinku drives it past the bowler to long-off's left
Full toss outside off, flicked wide of long-on. They race to get two
Bumped in short. Rinku ducks. And the umpire waits a while before signalling wide
Yorker on the stumps, Raghuvanshi squeezes it out through point
Clipped out through square leg for a single
In the blockhole on off, squeezed out to cover
Boult tries to follow Rinku who was backing away, but it's a full toss and Rinku flays this over point. Shot!

This one, he got a hold of alright! Tossed up too full again and Raghuvanshi plays the straightest of lofted straight drives and hammers it over the sightscreen. Raghuvanshi will want to make the most of his second life here!

Shelled at long-on by Rohit Sharma! And it's four, to add insult to injury Raghuvanshi takes on this slot ball but doesn't get all of it. Rohit looks to take the catch to his right but the ball bursts through and he drops it onto the boundary rope!
Raghuvanshi now looks for a reverse-sweep as Ghazanfar goes full and wide. Misses out

Full outside off, Rinku reaches out and squeezes it out between backward point and short third. Rohit at short third comes in and collects and nails the throw at the non-striker's end but Rinku was safely in. This was fired in at 110kph
Tossed up full outside off, Rinku eases a drive through the cover region. Long-off has a long way to make so they are able to pick up two
On a length outside off, Rinku swiftly backs away to this carrom ball, waits on it, and cuts it away through backward point. Great placement
Full toss on off, Raghuvanshi meets it with a crisp drive, but straight to the cover fielder
Slashes at it but the top edge finds the boundary. Short and wide and Raghuvanshi throws the kitchen sink at this slower ball. Goes flying over short third
Full on off and going across, Rinku jabs at it and gets an inside edge onto his pads. Ball drops to his left and they take the single

Shardul Thakur can do no wrong today! Three overs, three wickets! Rahane falls with the pressure building. Cross-seam full ball outside off. Rahane tries to go inside out but it comes off the toe end. Hardik Pandya at cover back-tracks and takes a simple catch. Rahane falls for 67 off 40, having laid the platform for his team
Looks for the yorker on off. Turns into a very low full toss and Raghuvanshi can only clip it out to deep midwicket
Starts off with a slower bouncer outside off. Raghuvanshi had backed away so he has to reach out but can't connect. Done in by the lack of pace there
Raghuvanshi backs away early and Boult tries to follow him. Squeezed out to cover for a single
A boundary after 15 balls! Cross-seam delivery is in the slot on leg and Raghuvanshi just flicks it away past short fine leg. The fielder had just moved finer and Raghuvanshi finds that gap
In the blockhole again, Raghuvanshi opens the bat face to steer it out to deep backward point
Boult goes for the wide yorker, Raghuvanshi looks to shuffle across and sweep him to the leg side, but is early into the shot on this cutter
Low full toss outside off as Boult searches for the yorker. Lobbed to long-on on the bounce
Very low full toss on the stumps, Rahane gets his bat down and keeps it out
132kph, full outside off and angling in, Rahane just flicks it away to deep midwicket on the bounce, happy to play Bumrah out
Bumrah goes pace off and very full again. Rahane manages to chip it back over the non-striker to get Rahane on strike
135kph in the blockhole around off. Raghuvanshi can only lob a bump ball back to the bowler
Bumrah nails this 134kph yorker on off. Rahane does just as well to jam his bat down and keep it out. Squeezes it out to the off side for a quick run
Looks for the yorker outside off, it pitches just a tad short. Raghuvanshi works it down to long on. This was at 115kph
Slower back of length ball outside off, Rahane sways back for the ramp, but there's no pace on this. Ends up dabbing it to short third
Full and quick on off, Raghuvanshi looks for the sweep but the ball ricochets off his gloves onto his body
Misses the big sweep but the umpire isn't moved. Rahane got down for the slog on this full ball outside off. Height an issue?
On a length outside off, punched back towards the non-striker. Ghazanfar shuffles across
This time the length is slightly shorter, but still around leg. Tucked off his pads through midwicket for two more
Tucked into the midwicket region and they'll ease their way to two. This was full on leg
Oh, that's huuuge! This is flat and full outside off but Rahane reaches out, gets under it, and launches it over long-on. Into the stands!
pulled to deep square, Boult took pace off and Rahane hit it off the bottom
whips this to deep square leg. Pinged the middle of his bat as he transferred his weight back
uses the width and the pace of Boult to unfurl a lovely little punch behind point. Opened the bat face late to find the gap
whipped to deep square leg
off a thick edge as he looks to flay this through point, it flies to short third where Markande misfields to concede two. Rahane brings up a half-century , his 34th in the IPL
full on the pad, flicked to wide long-on
steered to third man to get off the mark

dug in short, Green tries to get on top of the bounce and slap but has ended up picking the lone man at deep cover. Green will be livid with himself. Shardul took pace off, and the moment Green hit it he knew the timing was slightly off, and that was enough.
looks to sweep him off his length, but ends up smashing it onto his thigh pad, they take a run off the deflection
full on the pads, worked to the man at deep midwicket
uses the pace to direct this behind point! Green didn't try to hit it hard. Pure timing and placement. Gorgeous
too much width, Green reaches out to slap this towards wide long-off. Excellent running
pushed to deep cover for a single
tucked to square leg for a quick single, looks for a second but is sent back.100 up in real quick time for KKR
slides down, Rahane looking to paddle fine but lets it pass, wide called
short and sliding down, Green turns it gently to fine leg for a single
punched to deep point for a single. Once again there wasn't much turn
shortish and sliding down, tucked to long leg once again as they jog the single
works it down the ground to long-on
Green says I'm here too. This is too full and Green simply extends his arms and uses all that reach to great effect as he simply lofts this cleanly to hit that into the second tier over wide long-on.
whips this down to deep midwicket for a single

that is magical from Rahane! Flat-batted and straight down the ground to clear long-off. Mind you this wasn't full, in fact a length ball. Rahane's backswing was magnificent as he cleared his front leg and muscled it down town for a 75-metre hit.

massive appeal for lbw. The drift in may have made this tricky. Rahane played down the wrong line, and the impression was the ball was slipping down leg. But MI have opted to review. Replays confirm a clear gap between bat and ball. Ball tracking comes back to tell us this would've missed leg,  the not out call stays and MI lose a review
flatter one outside off once again, this one's shorter and Rahane punches this into the gap at deep extra cover. He's looked busy. And in sparkling form
pushed through quicker outside off, eased to long-off
sat up nicely as Rahane lofts him over his head for four! Clean strike that
mistimes a flat-batted pull to mid-on
punched on the up through extra cover, the timing and placement exquisite. Shardul took pace off, but Rahane still managed to time that beautifully.
pushed wide of cover to get off the mark.
lord strikes! Allen looks to go downtown but ends up dragging this slower delivery to wide long-on. KKR were running away with it, so this is a big wicket. That was bowled at 117kph.
pulled to deep square
pulled to deep square as they jog the single
flicked to midwicket
slapped to mid-off, they scamper a quick single. Hardik didn't pick it up cleanly.
hocked over midwicket! Not timed as well as he would've liked but swung hard at that. Bumrah went cutter on that occasion.
tucked past square leg for a single
uses the pace nicely to tickle it fine for four! Rahane's wrist work magical, Bumrah too straight on that occasion.
walks across and scoops this short ball from around sixth or seventh stump and still manages to hit it between keeper and short fine. Mayhem here!
too full and slaughtered down the ground, he couldn't have hit it straighter. Fifty up!
dug in short, down leg and over the batter's head. Wide called
pulled mercilessly, down towards the short leg-side boundary. Races past deep square
hit high on the body as he tries to work it to the leg side, they scamper a leg bye
one more, take that!  Too short, Rahane swivels around to hit this a lot flatter over the fine leg boundary. Rahane just used Hardik's pace and lent direction
half-volley on the pads and Rahane plays a sumptuous flick over deep backward square leg. Sails into the second-tier nearly.
into orbit again! Once again very short, Allen muscles this over deep midwicket. He'll put those away effortlessly
fuller, swung in late to hit the pad as Allen looked to whip it square. Going down leg
walloped into Navi Mumbai! Drops short again, Allen picked length early as he rocked back to pummel that over wide long-on.
now he's up and running! Too short and he rocks back to hammer that over square leg.
skids one through on a length as it drifts in, whipped to square leg
tucked through square leg for a single
beaten as he looks to wallop the pull in front of square
nice shape away off a length, pushed to mid-off again
fine enough for four! Not where he intended. Looked to pull, but flew off a thickish inside edge past short fine
punched firmly to mid-off, three dots in a row
punched back, Hardik puts his left hand out on his followthrough to stop
nice shape away from middle, defended back
defended back, not off the middle. Rolled off the inner half
on the pads and Rahane clips it nicely off the pads towards long leg, terrific work by Naman Dhir on the boundary - put in a full-length dive after running nearly 20 yards to save two runs
slants across a touch fuller, pushed to mid-off
right in the slot and Rahane whips him over mid-on! This one sails all the way.  Incredible timing and wrist work.  No swing on it on that occasion
reaches out to square drive, but this has slipped far too wide outside off, through to the keeper
slants across on a length, pushed to point
lovely shape, deadly accurate as it comes in from outside off, defended back
hint of swing in but slips down leg, wide called

And Mumbai Indians win their first season-opener since 2012! And they do it by pulling off their biggest chase! This is full on middle and Naman Dhir just makes room and drills it down the ground. Mumbai Indians begin with a comprehensive victory!
Finds the gap! Hardik Pandya levels the scores as he takes on this half-tracker. Pulls it away wide of long-off, an d MI are one run away
On a length outside off, punched down to long-off
Tilak picks out long-on! Slowed down to 83.1kph, it's an offbreak outside off. Tilak looks to go downtown but picks out Manish Pandey, who is a safe pair of hands
Full outside off, Pandya tries to swing it away to deep midwicket. His right hand came off the handle
On a length around off, clipped out through midwicket
On a length outside off, Pandya drills it down to long-off

That's just unlucky for the bowler! Nails the yorker as he follows Tilak down the leg side. Tilak jams his bat down and the ball ends up going through his feet and past the keeper. Umpire confers with Tilak and gives it as runs, even though it looked like it went off his boots!
Short ball angled across, Pandya this time waits on it and dabs it in the gap between deep backward point and deep third. Gets a single
Full toss on the stumps, Tilak digs it out towards long-off
125kph short ball sits up nicely, and there's width on offer as well. Tilak stands tall and slashes it over backward point
Good bouncer, cramping Pandya for room. He looks to pull but gloves it into the square leg region
Short around leg and angled across him. Pandya looks for the cut but can't make contact

That was a good over till now, but Tilak has the final word. He goes well across to this full toss outside off and scoops it over short fine. That was fired at 143/6kph, but Tilak played that with ease
Bouncer wide of off, pace off, Pandya toe-ends it down to long-on

Did that pitch outside leg? Looked pretty plumb otherwise! 145kph full delivery around leg and Tilak swings across the line and misses. The ball crashes into his pad. Tyagi convinces Rinku to review. Yes, that did pitch outside leg and KKR lose a review
Good stuff from Kartik as he nails the wide yorker. Tilak tries to squeeze it away but can't reach it
Slower ball, full outside off, Pandya tries to swing it away leg side but gets an inside edge onto his pads that deflects towards cover
Tyagi nearly has a second wicket there as Tilak miscues this pull. Slower bouncer angled across him and he gets this off high on the bat. goes on the bounce to deep midwicket
Short and wide again, this time he just manages to toe end to cover. Muzarabani lucky that one didn't go in the gap as well
Short and wide again, and Pandya punishes it again! Cut away mercilessly. In the gap between deep cover and deep third
Like SKY and Tilak before him, Hardik starts off with a boundary! This is short and wide, pace off, Hardik waits on it and whacks it away through cover point
Wide yorker, squeezed out through point

Muzarabani goes pace off again, and oh wait that's a direct hit and Rickelton is run-out in a bit of bizarre fashion! Rickelton punches this down towards long-off and wants a second, but Tilak sends him back. But as Rickelton turns to get back to the crease at the non-striker's end, he is blocked by Muzarabani, who was trying to get behind the line of the throw from the deep, which ends up hitting the stumps! Rickelton immediately sets off, knowing he was a goner. No complaints there either, as Muzarabani seemingly wasn't intentionally trying to block him. Anukul Roy again with heroics on the field!
Slower ball on a length angled across him, Rickelton chops it towards cover
Yorker outside off, 144ks, Tilak hams his bat down and it goes off the outside edge to short third on the bounce. Good over from Tyagi. Great pace, great changes of pace as well
Slower short ball angled across him, stays low, and Tilak loses shape as he tries to pull that away
Now Tyagi takes the pace off as Tilak is early into his swipe across the line
Mumbai Indians just having fun now! Facing his first ball, Tilak shimmies out and thwacks this full ball through the gap at cover. That was fired in at 145/5kph, but Tilak made that look so easy

Tyagi gets some reward for his efforts. 141kph back of length ball. SKY stays still and looks to swing it away. Gets the height but not the distance, and Rinku Singh shows good judgement on the boundary rope at deep midwicket to pouch that and keep his balance

What can you even do there? Ankit bangs in a slower bouncer that veers in. SKY is swaying away and tries to ramp. The ball goes off the gloves onto the bat and goes in the very small gap between short third and a very fine backward point player

Pumped down the ground and beats long-off! Full and wide, Rickelton gets low, reaches out, and hits it cross-bat and straight of the fielder. Picked ahead of his compatriot Quinton de Kock, who is an IPL champion with MI, this is a statement knock today from Ryan Rickelton
Cramps Rickelton with a 108kph ball fired in close to off and angled into the batter. Rickelton gets his bat down to keep it out
That'll be a wide. Varun tries to keep it away from Rickelton's range, but ends up going outside the wide line
On a length outside off, punched out to deep cover
That's not short enough for the pull but Rickelton only manages to heave it away to deep square leg for a single. That was fired in at 106 clicks
Great fielding from Kartik Tyagi! This is short and wide and SKY craftily cuts it behind him at backward point but he puts in a good dive to stop that
Full and straying down leg, SKY edges forward and flicks it away through midwicket, his wristwork giving the fielder in the deep no chance
Long and mighty six from Rickelton! This is full and very wide, but Rickelton uses his long levers to reach that and clobber it over long-off
Low full toss on leg, Surya works it down to long-on
Anukul ends up tossing this outside the wide line, as he tries to keep it out of SKY's arc
Skips out to turn this into a low full toss on middle, flicked out to deep midwicket
Tossed up on middle, tucked to deep midwicket
Full and wide, toe-ended down to long-on
Angles this across him, taking it away and Rickelton can't connect
SKY starts off as SKY loves to! Full ball well outside off and going across him, SKY just shuffles across and scoops this in trademark Suryakumar Yadav style over fine leg

Anukul Roy hangs on to a clanger! He has a habit of those! 137kph full ball angled across, Rohit looks to slog it away but it comes off the top edge. Anukul Roy is running back from mid-on and has to put in a full-length dive to hold on to that. The bowler applauds that effort as Rohit walks off. MI and Rohit Sharma fans, you can blame Praveen there for that timely comment
Short ball angled across, Rohit watches it sail over him as the umpire calls a wide
130kph short ball outside off, Rickelton keeps it down as he pulls it out to deep midwicket
Now Vaibhav goes full outside off, carved over cover to the fielder in the deep

Inside out again! That's filth from Arora, a full toss outside off. And Rohit Sharma, in the kind of form he's displaying, is going to put those away every time. Flayed over cover with ease. Rohit doesn't even follow the ball with his eyes
Easy does it! Rohit skips down the track, Vaibhav pulls back his length but it matters not as Rohit pulls it away on the move through midwicket
Beats backward point. That's a bit poor from Varun, short and wide. Rickelton just reaches out and slaps it away
Loopy and in the blockhole, Rohit eases it down towards long-on
Punched out to the off side for a single as this length ball angles in on the stumps from outside off
Good comeback from Varun! On a length outside off, and it spins in to beat the cut
Wallopped over long-on! Full outside off, enough width for Ricks to free his arms, and he gets down on one knee and whacks a flat six
On a length outside leg at 103ks, tucked through midwicket
pulled to deep square, where Cam Green throws himself around to cut that off
whips this from outside off towards deep midwicket
more agony for Tyagi and KKR. This time Rohit simply opens the bat face and uses the pace to deflect this behind point. This is MI's highest opening stand in the IPL at Wankhede
hits hard length, Rickelton looks to flay that through the off side, the ball thuds into the top part of the bat as it rolls past the bowler, they jog the single

helped along to deep square and it's put down by Vaibhav Arora. This was hit hard and flat, should have been taken. Vaibhav ran in quickly from the ropes, was in good position but that didn't stick. Could prove to be very costly.
through with the pull long before the ball arrived, hit on the ribs

high full toss into the body. Rohit is thrown off balance by the height as he looks to pull. The ball rolls to square leg. Tyagi put his hand out in apology immediately. Did that hit Rohit's index finger on the right hand? He's in some pain, but there's no need fo rmagic spray he says.
length outside off, punched straight to cover
cut away towards deep point, good work from Anukul Roy
turns it down to long-on as they jog the single,  Ricketon raises a half-century now off 24 balls
this one's smashed over deep square! Down one one knee in a jiffy as he picks the length and deposits it deep into the stands. This is exhilarating stuff.
tucks it to the leg side

another chance, can someone take it? Yes, but outside the boundary. Rickelton slog-sweeps this full delivery from outside off over deep midwicket. Manish Pandey was back-pedalling at the ropes, and even someone of his athletic ability couldn't do much about it.
works it with the angle towards deep midwicket
mistimes a cut to the man at the edge of the ring at cover
pushed through quicker on leg stump, worked towards deep midwicket for a single
right in the slot and that has been smashed! Rohit backs away and gets underneath the length to tonk it over cover, one bounce to the ropes.
that's a chance and KKR can't take it. Got to say it was a tough one with Ramandeep running back from cover. But there was an opportunity. Rickelton was looking to go over long-off, didn't time it.
cut way to deep point for a single as Varun continues from around the stumps to Rohit
rocks back to slap this straight to cover. A good over under the circumstances despite that six. Just eight off it.
pushed to cover, dot ball, a rarity
slog-swept into the crowd over deep midwicket! Excellent pick up shot. Narine erred just a hint on the fuller side and Rickelton was ready. Incredible hand-eye coordination.
skids one through on a length, pushed to long-on for a single
spins back in a long way as Rohit lunges forward and defends back
pushed to long off as they jog the single. Narine starts with one full on the stumps
pulled well, pulled into the gap at deep midwicket.  Rohit raises a half-century off just 23 balls.  Sensational stuff.
yorker-length outside off, dug out to cover

it didn't seem like Rohit had timed it all that well, but even that mishit has sailed over deep midwicket for six! Tyagi dug it in short on middle and off, Rohit swivelled quickly to pull that away, even if not off the middle.
much better, shortens his length just a touch, a lot tighter outside off, defended back
tucks it to deep square leg, they saunter back for a second.
and is welcomed to the crease with a six! Typical Rohit stroke. Tyagi overpitches with this off-cutter and Rohit stays besides the line as he lofts him inside-out to clear extra cover.
fired full on leg-stump, flicked to long leg for a single. Big over that
bunts this to the man coming in from point. This was pushed through a lot quicker and across the right-hander.
and more runs! Varun under the pump. Rohit toying with the bowling. Moves across a hint to get inside the line and help it over square leg. Easily done.
full on the stumps, tucked to the leg side.

this is huge, this is massive, and this is gorgeous!   We saw Kohli play a lofted hit dead straight last night for six. This one's lofted cleanly over cover, Rohit just caressed it. And it sailed away. Wow, just wow.
welcomes Varun with a lofted hit over cover!  Beautifully held his shape and went inside out as he got to the pitch of the ball. Sumptuous from Rohit
slower ball angling across, Rickelton throws his bat at that to get a thick edge on the bounce to short third. Dot ball to end but MI are well on the move and on track
clean strike, good strike. Four! This is short and slanting across, and Rickelton unleashes a delightful cross-batted wallop. No chance for mid-on even if he was 10 feet tall.
fetches this slower-ball bouncer from way outside off, helps it down past short fine for a single
slower length ball angling away, pushed to point for a single
worked past square leg for a single
more agony for KKR as Rohit sashays down the pitch, makes a bit of room and slaps this over extra cover. Clean swing, right off the middle and that flies over the cover point fence.

pulled and that'll stay hit too! Just about clears deep midwicket. Ended up getting more elevation than distance. But somehow managed to just clear that short boundary on the leg side. Rickelton had to fetch it from outside off, didn't time it as well as he would've liked, but it's six nonetheless. MI get going finally.
throws his hands at that and he's lofted this over extra cover. Properly in the slot, and the width and Ricketon said thank you very much.
beauty! This one swings from outside leg to outside off, Rickelton is beaten as he tries to ease it into the off side.
flicked down to deep backward square leg for a single, Ramandeep the man
that has been deposited deep into the stands! Rohit had already picked his spot, some amount of premeditation as he wallops this 87-metre hit in front of square to clear deep midwicket.
gets this to bend back in a long way from outside off, Rohit bunts it to the off side and wants a single, but is sent back
slower and angling across a length. punched to cover
high, very high but the ball plonks near the long-on region and then dribbles away for four. Rickelton got it high on the bat but the intent was the key there. Muzarabani shouldn't mind this.
steered down to square third man for a single. That short of a length delivery was clocked at 138.3kph
off a thick inside edge and it flies pas leg stump for four! Rohit was looking to pull in front of square but was rushed into the shot. Lucky runs
lovely from Muzarabani. Gets this to angle in and hit good length on middle, Rohit is onto his toes as he bunts it to the leg side
starts well, hits hard length on off as Rohit rises the bounce and defends to the off side
throws his bat at that one, but is beaten again by the late away movement. Excellent start by Arora
beauty! This one leave him late as Rickelton is squared up in trying to punch that. He's getting appreciable seam movement. Lovely to watch
punched to point, excellent stop by Anukul Roy moving swiftly to his left.
looks to flay that on the up but the ball flies off a thick edge to third man where Muzarabani, on IPL debut, has made a mess of that. Lets it through his legs for four.
deflects off the thigh pad to square leg, they trot across for a leg bye
nips one away from length on middle, steered to point for a single
